tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Use this when a traveler asks which See Sight Tours day tour, private tour or multi-day trip fits a city, starting point, date range, length or interest. Returns active products with stable ids, canonical seesight-tours.com links, from-prices and how each one books. Use location for where the tour h

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Use this when the traveler wants the facts about one See Sight Tours product: what is included and excluded, itinerary, meeting point or pickup, cancellation terms, price options and the right page to book or request it. Only states facts published on seesight-tours.com.

tools.name: plan_itinerary
tools.description: Use this when a traveler wants a day-by-day plan from a starting city for a number of days (optionally an end city, start date and interests). Returns packaged See Sight Tours trips that fit the route and a day-tour plan from the base city, and lists which prices or dates need a dated quote.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Use this when the traveler has picked a product and a date and wants open times and the exact total for their party. Reads live seats and prices; returns each departure's status, the total in minor units (cents) and a quote_id for create_checkout_session. Trips need one age per child in child_ages.

tools.name: create_checkout_session
tools.description: Use this when the traveler confirms a quoted departure and wants to book. Returns a short-lived seesight-tours.com link that restores the product, departure, party and currency. Nothing is reserved or charged: the guest reviews the final total and pays on the website. Never ask for card or contact d

tools.name: get_quote_link
tools.description: Use this when a product is booked by request (multi-day trips, private or custom dates) or the traveler wants a quote. Returns the See Sight Tours request form link; the traveler enters contact details and consent there. No payment is taken.

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Use this when the traveler asks whether a checkout link from this app still works. Returns prepared or expired. It cannot see payments or bookings: the confirmation email and the See Sight Tours site are the booking record.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking_status · Private data: search_products, create_checkout_session, get_quote_link, get_booking_status · Public sink: get_booking_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking_status · Private data: search_products, create_checkout_session, get_quote_link, get_booking_status · Public sink: get_booking_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
